module autovcoder_075105 (
    input             CCD_PIXCLK,    //50MHZ
    input             mCCD_FVAL,
    input             mCCD_LVAL,
    input      [ 9:0] mCCD_DATA,
    input      [15:0] X_Cont,
    input             VGA_CLK,       // 25MHZ 
    input             READ_Request,
    input             VGA_VS,
    input      [12:0] READ_Cont,
    input      [12:0] V_Cont,
    output     [ 9:0] taps0x,
    output     [ 9:0] taps1x,
    output reg [ 1:0] WR,
    output            WR0,
    WR1,
    WR2



);




  //====== WIRE /REG  ==== 					
  wire [9:0] T0;
  wire [9:0] T1;
  wire [9:0] T2;

  //====== WIRE /REG  ==== 	

  //----3 SRAM BUFFER  WRITE ENABLE  COUNTER -----
  reg pre_CCD_LVAL;
  always @(posedge CCD_PIXCLK or negedge mCCD_FVAL)
    if (!mCCD_FVAL) begin
      WR <= 0;
      pre_CCD_LVAL <= mCCD_LVAL;
    end else begin
      pre_CCD_LVAL <= mCCD_LVAL;
      if (pre_CCD_LVAL && !mCCD_LVAL) begin
        if (WR >= 2) WR <= 0;
        else WR <= WR + 1;
      end
    end

  //----3 SRAM BUFFER  WRITE ENABLE  -----	
  assign WR0 = (WR == 0) ? 1 : 0;
  assign WR1 = (WR == 1) ? 1 : 0;
  assign WR2 = (WR == 2) ? 1 : 0;

  //--- OUT0  SELECTION--- 
  assign taps0x = READ_Request ? (((WR == 0) ? T1 : ((WR == 1) ? T2 : ((WR == 2) ? T0 : T0)))) : 0;

  //--- OUT1  SELECTION--- 
  assign taps1x = READ_Request ? (((WR == 0) ? T2 : ((WR == 1) ? T0 : ((WR == 2) ? T1 : T1)))) : 0;
  //
  //always @( posedge VGA_CLK ) begin   
  //taps0x <= READ_Request ? (  (
  //   ( WR==0)? T1: (  
  //   ( WR==1)? T2: (  
  //   ( WR==2)? T0: T0 
  //	)))) :0 ;
  //
  ////--- OUT1  SELECTION--- 
  //taps1x <= READ_Request ? (  (
  //   ( WR==0)? T2: (  
  //   ( WR==1)? T0: (  
  //   ( WR==2)? T1: T1
  //	))))  :0 ;
  //end 
  //	
  //---0 : 2PORT LINE BUFFER 	
  int_line d1 (
      .wrclock  (CCD_PIXCLK),
      .data     (mCCD_DATA),
      .wraddress(X_Cont),
      .wren     (WR0 & mCCD_LVAL),
      .rdclock  (VGA_CLK),
      .rdaddress(READ_Cont),
      .q        (T0)
  );

  //---1 : 2PORT LINE BUFFER 						
  int_line d2 (
      .wrclock  (CCD_PIXCLK),
      .data     (mCCD_DATA),
      .wraddress(X_Cont),
      .wren     (WR1 & mCCD_LVAL),
      .rdclock  (VGA_CLK),
      .rdaddress(READ_Cont),
      .q        (T1)
  );

  //---2 : 2PORT LINE BUFFER 		
  int_line d3 (
      .wrclock  (CCD_PIXCLK),
      .data     (mCCD_DATA),
      .wraddress(X_Cont),
      .wren     (WR2 & mCCD_LVAL),
      .rdclock  (VGA_CLK),
      .rdaddress(READ_Cont),
      .q        (T2)
  );


endmodule
